decanter-2016.name: Decanter, Brunello di Montalcino 2016 vintage report (Michaela Morris)
decanter-2016.note: Decanter score known only from a search-result summary; page is paywalled and was not read. Rating 5/5.

claims.claim: January was cold, with 12 days below freezing, which cleaned the vineyards of disease. A rainy winter followed and built groundwater.
Rain fell regularly until early spring. Budding, flowering and fruit set went without trouble, and fungal pressure stayed low.
claims.note: Two sources agree. No frost or hail was reported in either.

claims.claim: Summer was warm with intermittent showers until August, a peak near 35C and no 40C spikes. Large day-night swings slowed ripening and kept aromas and acidity.
claims.note: Italy's Finest Wines puts the rain in mid-July. A search summary of other sources says July was hot and dry with one rain in mid-August. Detail varies, the pattern of warm days and cool nights does not.

claims.claim: Harvest began around 18 to 19 September at Talenti and Biondi-Santi, 27 September at Canalicchio di Sopra (about 10 days) and early October at Sassetti. Low-altitude plots at Poggio di Sotto were picked from 2 September.
claims.note: Estate dates from one source. Rain in mid-September then dry breezes is reported in a search summary only.

claims.claim: Yields were good and healthy, with no regional over-production. Canalicchio di Sopra cropped below the 8,000 kg/ha cap.
claims.note: One source. No official volume figure found.

claims.claim: Sangiovese is fresh and precise, with floral lift, firm acidity, red fruit and ripe, enveloping tannins. It is more 'vertical' and classic than the broader 2015.
Producers compare it to 2006, 2010 and 2013 and expect long ageing.
The Consorzio rated 2016 five stars, 'outstanding'. Decanter reportedly gives 5/5.
claims.note: Consorzio page read directly. Decanter score from a search summary only.

claims.claim: Szabo calls 2016 said to be even better than 2015.

conflicts: Summer rain timing differs between sources (mid-July showers versus a dry July with one mid-August rain).
gaps: No Consorzio weather report or official yield figure found.
Frost, hail: none reported, but no source addressed them directly.

sheet.vintage: 2016 had a cold January, a steady spring and warm days with cool nights. The Sangiovese is fresh, precise and floral, and the Consorzio gave it five stars.
